items.text: Houston (Thu practice): DNP - LB Azeez Al-Shaair (groin/personal, 2nd straight day), RB David Montgomery (groin, ramping up but Ryans not committing to a Wk10 return). RB Woody Marks (knee) left Wednesday's practice early and was not practicing Thursday; G Keylan Rutledge working through a stinger (DNP Wed). Wed report also had DNP - TE Brevin Jordan (finger/foot); Limited - S Reed Blankenship (concussion/hand), WR Tank Dell, WR Marvin Harrison Jr. (hamstring), CB Jaylin Smith, LB Jacob Hummel, G Wyatt Teller (illness). C.J. Stroud expected to start.
items.source: ClutchPoints via Yahoo Sports (Montgomery back at practice, Nov 12)

items.text: Cleveland (Thu practice): DNP - WR Denzel Boston (toe, team's leading receiver; Monken calls it 'a little toe issue'), S Ronnie Hickman (concussion), FB Michael Burton (calf). C Elgton Jenkins (knee) returned to practice Thursday. Wed limited: CB Denzel Ward (quad), LB Carson Schwesinger (wrist/ankle), LB Quincy Williams (hamstring), TE Harold Fannin Jr. (groin), OT Tytus Howard (knee), OT Austin Barber (calf), DT Maliek Collins (elbow).
items.source: PFT/NBC Sports via Yahoo Sports (Boston remains out of Thursday's practice, Nov 12)

items.text: Cleveland QB: the Browns confirmed Deshaun Watson (cleared concussion protocol) is set to start vs. Houston over Shedeur Sanders, who started Wk9.
items.source: NBC Sports / PFT (Browns plan on starting Watson, Nov 11)
